scripts.build: cd anchor && anchor build --no-idl --ignore-keys && anchor idl build -o target/idl/pm_amm.json -t target/types/pm_amm.ts
scripts.deploy: bash -c 'source app/.env.local 2>/dev/null; solana program deploy anchor/target/deploy/pm_amm.so --keypair ${DEVNET_UPGRADE_KEYPAIR:-~/.config/solana/pm-amm-devnet-upgrade.json} --program-id anchor/target/deploy/pm_amm-keypair.json --url "${NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL:-https://api.devnet.solana.com}"'
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter @pm-amm/sdk type-check && cd app && pnpm tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:all: cd anchor && cargo test --package pm_amm && cd ../oracle && python3 -m pytest test_oracle.py test_properties.py -v
scripts.musdc: cd anchor && ANCHOR_PROVIDER_URL=https://api.devnet.solana.com ANCHOR_WALLET=${MINT_AUTHORITY_KEYPAIR:-~/.config/solana/pm-amm-devnet-mint.json} pnpm exec ts-node --transpile-only -P ./tsconfig.json scripts/mint-usdc.ts
scripts.seed: pnpm run build:sdk && bash -c 'set -a; source app/.env.local 2>/dev/null; set +a; NODE_PATH="$PWD/app/node_modules" node scripts/seed-devnet.cjs'
